title.en: Pipe fittings and joints—classification and uses
title.gu: Pipe Fittings તથા Joints—વર્ગીકરણ અને ઉપયોગો

h.en: Pipe fittings and joints—classification and uses
h.gu: Pipe Fittings તથા Joints—વર્ગીકરણ અને ઉપયોગો

body.en:
Definition and principle

Fittings change direction, size, branching or termination of a piping path. Joints connect individual pipe/tube sections. Elbows/bends change direction, tees/wyes form branches, reducers connect sizes, couplings/unions join lengths and caps/plugs close ends.

Important points

Threaded joints are detachable but depend on compatible threads/sealing; flanged joints use bolts and gaskets and permit equipment removal. Welded joints provide permanent connections requiring qualified procedures. Socket/compression/flared joints suit specified tube services. Selection depends on pressure, temperature, material, corrosion, cleanability, vibration and leakage risk. A union permits disconnection without rotating a whole pipe; it is not identical to an ordinary coupling.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા અને સિદ્ધાંત

Piping path ની direction, size, branching અથવા termination બદલતા parts Fittings છે.Pipe/tube sections ને જોડતી connections Joints છે.Elbows/bends direction બદલે છે, tees/wyes branches, reducers size changes, couplings/unions lengths જોડે છે તથા caps/plugs ends બંધ કરે છે.

મહત્વના મુદ્દા

Threaded joints detachable છે, પણ યોગ્ય threads/sealing જરૂરી છે.Flanged joint માં bolts તથા gasket હોય છે અને equipment removal સરળ બને છે.Welded joints permanent છે તથા qualified procedure જોઈએ.Socket/compression/flared joints specified tube services માટે છે.Pressure, temperature, material, corrosion, cleanability, vibration તથા leakage risk પ્રમાણે પસંદગી કરો.Union થી આખી pipe ફેરવ્યા વગર disconnect થાય છે; તે ordinary coupling જેવું નથી.

body.en:
Definition

A gate valve is primarily an isolation valve that opens a nearly straight flow passage by lifting a gate.

Construction

A pressure-containing body and bonnet enclose seats and a wedge/parallel gate. The stem connects the gate to a handwheel/actuator, with packing controlling stem leakage. Rising-stem and non-rising-stem designs differ; the sketch shows a rising closure element.

Working and applications

Turning the operator raises the gate away from both seats for full opening or lowers it into the seat region for shut-off. When fully open, obstruction and pressure loss are relatively low. Part-opening creates a high-velocity jet, vibration and seat/gate erosion, so an ordinary gate valve is not preferred for routine throttling. Use it for suitable line isolation; verify pressure direction, actuation and seating requirements for the actual design.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Gate Valve મુખ્યત્વે isolation માટે છે; gate ઊંચું થતાં આશરે straight flow passage ખૂલે છે.

રચના (Construction)

Pressure-containing body તથા bonnet માં seats અને wedge/parallel gate હોય છે.Stem gate ને handwheel/actuator સાથે જોડે છે.Stem leakage માટે packing હોય છે.Rising તથા non-rising stem designs જુદા છે; sketch માં closure element ઊંચું થતું દર્શાવ્યું છે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ અને ઉપયોગો

Operator ફેરવતાં gate seats થી ઉપર જઈ full opening આપે છે અથવા નીચે આવી shut-off કરે છે.Fully open condition માં obstruction તથા pressure loss ઓછાં હોય છે.Part-opening માં high-velocity jet, vibration તથા seat/gate erosion થાય છે; તેથી ordinary gate valve routine throttling માટે યોગ્ય પસંદગી નથી.Compatible line isolation માટે વાપરો.Actual design ની pressure direction, actuation તથા seating requirements તપાસો.

body.en:
Definition

A globe valve controls flow by moving a disc/plug toward or away from a seat in a partitioned flow path.

Construction

The body has an internal passage that changes flow direction, a bonnet, stem, packing, seat and handwheel/actuator. The stem movement is approximately normal to the seat opening.

Working and applications

Lifting the disc increases the annular seat opening; lowering it reduces flow and eventually closes the passage. The local restriction permits controlled throttling, but the changing path causes greater pressure loss than a fully open straight-through isolation valve. It is useful for appropriate regulating service; follow the body flow arrow and allowable pressure drop to avoid erosion, cavitation or unstable operation.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Globe Valve માં partitioned flow path ના seat તરફ/દૂર disc અથવા plug ખસેડીને flow control થાય છે.

રચના (Construction)

Body ની અંદર direction-changing passage, bonnet, stem, packing, seat તથા handwheel/actuator હોય છે.Stem movement આશરે seat opening ને normal હોય છે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ અને ઉપયોગો

Disc ઊંચો કરતાં seat ની annular opening વધે છે; નીચે કરતાં flow ઘટે છે અને અંતે passage બંધ થાય છે.Local restriction થી controlled throttling મળે છે, પણ direction-changing path ના કારણે fully open straight-through isolation valve કરતાં pressure loss વધારે છે.Regulating service માટે ઉપયોગી છે.Body નો flow arrow તથા allowable pressure drop અનુસરો, જેથી erosion, cavitation અથવા instability ટાળી શકાય.

body.en:
Definition

A check valve permits flow preferentially in one direction and closes against reverse flow.

Construction

A swing-check example contains a body, seat, hinged disc and hinge pin; other designs use lift discs, balls or springs. It normally has no handwheel for routine opening.

Working and applications

Forward differential pressure lifts or swings the disc from its seat. Reversal or reduced forward flow allows weight, spring force or reverse differential pressure to seat it. It prevents backflow in suitable pump lines but is not a universal positive-isolation substitute. Install in the specified orientation and direction. Rapid closure can contribute to water hammer; proper selection and system analysis matter.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Check Valve એક direction માં flow પસાર કરે છે અને reverse flow સામે બંધ થાય છે.

રચના (Construction)

Swing-check example માં body, seat, hinged disc તથા hinge pin હોય છે.Other designs માં lift disc, ball અથવા spring હોઈ શકે છે.Routine opening માટે સામાન્ય રીતે handwheel નથી.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ અને ઉપયોગો

Forward differential pressure થી disc seat થી ઊંચો થાય અથવા swing થાય છે.Flow reverse/ઘટતાં weight, spring અથવા reverse differential થી disc seat થાય છે.Pump lines માં suitable backflow prevention આપે છે, પણ universal positive-isolation substitute નથી.Specified orientation તથા direction માં install કરો.Rapid closure થી water hammer થઈ શકે છે; યોગ્ય selection તથા system analysis જરૂરી છે.

body.en:
Definition

A butterfly valve is a quarter-turn valve with a disc rotating inside the flow bore.

Construction

The disc is carried by a shaft through the body and seals against a compatible resilient or metal seat. Bearings, seals and a lever/geared actuator support positioning; the disc remains in the passage even when open.

Working and applications

With the disc plane roughly parallel to the flow, the passage is open. Rotation toward the transverse position restricts and then shuts flow. It is compact and useful for large-bore lines and appropriate control/isolation duties, but pressure rating, seat compatibility and permitted throttling range are design-dependent. High differential pressure can create torque, vibration or cavitation; it is not automatically suitable for every regulating condition.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Butterfly Valve quarter-turn valve છે; flow bore ની અંદર disc rotate થાય છે.

રચના (Construction)

Body માંથી shaft disc ને support આપે છે અને compatible resilient અથવા metal seat પર sealing થાય છે.Bearings, seals તથા lever/geared actuator positioning માટે છે.Open હોય ત્યારે પણ disc passage માં રહે છે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ અને ઉપયોગો

Disc plane flow ને આશરે parallel હોય ત્યારે passage open છે.Transverse position તરફ rotate કરતાં restriction વધે છે અને flow બંધ થાય છે.Compact હોવાથી large-bore lines તથા suitable control/isolation માટે ઉપયોગી છે.Pressure rating, seat compatibility તથા throttling range design મુજબ છે.High differential pressure થી torque, vibration અથવા cavitation થઈ શકે છે; દરેક regulating condition માટે આપમેળે suitable નથી.

body.en:
Definition

A ball valve is a quarter-turn valve whose bored spherical closure aligns with or turns across the flow passage.

Construction

The body encloses the ball, seats, stem and stem seals. A lever/actuator rotates the ball. Full-bore and reduced-bore designs have different internal flow areas.

Working and applications

When the bore aligns with the pipe, fluid passes through it; approximately 90°rotation presents the solid ball surface to shut off flow. It provides rapid isolation and, for a full-bore open design, low flow resistance. Ordinary shut-off balls are not automatically precision throttling valves; use a suitable characterised control design when regulation is required. Trapped liquid between closed seats may require appropriate thermal-pressure protection.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Ball Valve quarter-turn valve છે; તેના spherical closure નો bore flow passage સાથે align અથવા across થાય છે.

રચના (Construction)

Body માં ball, seats, stem તથા stem seals હોય છે.Lever/actuator ball rotate કરે છે.Full-bore તથા reduced-bore designs ના internal flow areas જુદા હોય છે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ અને ઉપયોગો

Bore pipe સાથે align હોય ત્યારે fluid પસાર થાય છે.આશરે 90°rotation પછી solid ball surface flow બંધ કરે છે.Rapid isolation તથા full-bore open design માં ઓછો resistance મળે છે.Ordinary shut-off ball valve precision throttling માટે આપમેળે suitable નથી; regulation માટે યોગ્ય characterised design લો.Closed seats વચ્ચે trapped liquid માટે યોગ્ય thermal-pressure protection જરૂરી થઈ શકે છે.

body.en:
Definition and principle

A pump supplies mechanical energy to move a liquid or increase its pressure/head. First classify positive-displacement and rotodynamic pumps. Positive-displacement types include reciprocating piston/plunger/diaphragm and rotary gear/screw/vane pumps. Rotodynamic types include radial centrifugal, mixed-flow and axial-flow designs.

Important points

Selection considers required flow/head, viscosity, solids, corrosion, temperature, NPSH, efficiency, sealing and maintenance. Positive-displacement delivery depends mainly on displacement and speed but leakage/compressibility affect actual flow; it must have suitable overpressure protection and must not be deadheaded. Centrifugal flow is set by pump/system-curve interaction, not impeller speed alone.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા અને સિદ્ધાંત

Liquid ને ખસેડવા અથવા pressure/head વધારવા mechanical energy આપતું equipment Pump છે.પ્રથમ Positive-displacement તથા Rotodynamic વર્ગીકરણ કરો.Positive-displacement માં reciprocating piston/plunger/diaphragm તથા rotary gear/screw/vane types આવે છે.Rotodynamic માં radial centrifugal, mixed-flow તથા axial-flow designs આવે છે.

મહત્વના મુદ્દા

Required flow/head, viscosity, solids, corrosion, temperature, NPSH, efficiency, sealing તથા maintenance પ્રમાણે પસંદગી કરો.Positive-displacement delivery મુખ્યત્વે displacement તથા speed પર છે, પણ leakage/compressibility actual flow ને અસર કરે છે.યોગ્ય overpressure protection જરૂરી છે; deadhead ન કરવો.Centrifugal flow pump/system curves ના intersection થી નક્કી થાય છે, ફક્ત speed થી નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

A centrifugal pump transfers shaft energy to liquid through a rotating impeller.

Construction

A casing surrounds the impeller, with a central suction eye and tangential/appropriate discharge passage. The shaft, bearings, seal and driver support rotation. A volute or diffuser collects liquid and converts part of velocity energy into pressure; foot valves and priming connections are arrangement-dependent accessories.

Working and applications

For a non-self-priming installation, fill the casing/suction route as required before start-up. The impeller accelerates incoming liquid outward and transfers angular momentum; the casing/diffuser recovers pressure. Lower eye pressure draws replacement liquid from the suction source. The actual operating flow is where pump and system head requirements agree. Use manufacturer start-up/valve instructions, never assume dry operation or prolonged shut-off is safe. Common uses include water and compatible low-to-moderate viscosity process liquids.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Centrifugal Pump rotating impeller મારફતે shaft energy liquid ને આપે છે.

રચના (Construction)

Impeller આસપાસ casing, central suction eye તથા યોગ્ય discharge passage હોય છે.Shaft, bearings, seal તથા driver rotation માટે છે.Volute/diffuser liquid collect કરીને velocity energy નો ભાગ pressure માં ફેરવે છે.Foot valve તથા priming connections arrangement પ્રમાણેના accessories છે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ અને ઉપયોગો

Non-self-priming installation માં start-up પહેલાં SOP મુજબ casing/suction route ભરો.Impeller incoming liquid ને બહાર accelerate કરીને angular momentum આપે છે.Casing/diffuser pressure recover કરે છે.Eye પાસે ઓછા pressure થી source માંથી replacement liquid આવે છે.Pump તથા system head requirements મળતા operating flow મળે છે.Manufacturer ના start-up/valve instructions અનુસરો.Dry operation અથવા prolonged shut-off ને safe ન માનો.Water તથા compatible low-to-moderate viscosity liquids માટે સામાન્ય ઉપયોગ છે.

body.en:
Definition

A reciprocating pump is a positive-displacement machine using a piston/plunger moving within a cylinder.

Construction

A crank/connecting mechanism converts shaft rotation to reciprocation. Suction and delivery non-return valves connect the chamber to their respective pipes. Seals and a suitable relief arrangement are essential; an air vessel may smooth pulsation but is not present in every rig.

Working and applications

During the suction stroke, chamber volume increases, pressure falls and the suction valve admits liquid while the delivery valve remains closed. During delivery, the piston reduces chamber volume, the suction valve closes and the delivery valve opens when chamber pressure exceeds line pressure. Single-acting operation discharges on one stroke per cycle; double-acting operation uses both piston sides with rod-area correction. Pulsating delivery and leakage distinguish actual from theoretical flow. It suits appropriate low-flow/high-head or metering services.

Governing relation
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Reciprocating Pump cylinder માં piston/plunger ની આગળ-પાછળ motion થી કામ કરતું positive-displacement machine છે.

રચના (Construction)

Crank/connecting mechanism rotation ને reciprocation માં ફેરવે છે.Suction તથા delivery non-return valves chamber ને respective pipes સાથે જોડે છે.Seals તથા યોગ્ય relief arrangement જરૂરી છે.Air vessel pulsation ઘટાડી શકે છે, પણ દરેક rig માં હોવું જરૂરી નથી.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ અને ઉપયોગો

Suction stroke માં chamber volume વધે છે, pressure ઘટે છે અને suction valve liquid અંદર લે છે; delivery valve બંધ રહે છે.Delivery stroke માં piston volume ઘટાડે છે, suction valve બંધ થાય છે અને chamber pressure line pressure કરતાં વધુ થતાં delivery valve ખૂલે છે.Single-acting માં cycle દીઠ એક stroke delivery આપે છે.Double-acting માં rod-area correction સાથે બંને sides કામ કરે છે.Pulsation તથા leakage થી actual/theoretical flow જુદા પડે છે.Low-flow/high-head અથવા suitable metering services માટે ઉપયોગી છે.

મૂળ સંબંધ

body.en:
Definition

A rotary positive-displacement pump traps liquid in moving cavities.

Construction

An external-gear example has two meshing gears closely enclosed by a casing, one driven and the other idling. Suction and discharge ports lie on opposite sides of the mesh. Shaft seals, bearings and an appropriate relief/bypass arrangement complete the installation.

Working and applications

As teeth disengage on the inlet side, cavity volume increases and liquid enters. Trapped liquid moves around the outer periphery between gear teeth and casing—not through the meshing contact. At the outlet, teeth re-engage and expel liquid against the delivery pressure. Gear pumps suit compatible viscous lubricating liquids; abrasive solids, poor lubrication and excessive pressure require specific design consideration. Flow depends on displacement/speed and slip; never close the discharge without an effective approved relief path.

Governing relation
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Rotary Positive-displacement Pump moving cavities માં liquid trap કરીને ખસેડે છે.

રચના (Construction)

External-gear example માં closely fitted casing ની અંદર બે meshing gears હોય છે; એક driven અને બીજો idler છે.Mesh ની opposite sides પર suction તથા discharge ports છે.Shaft seals, bearings તથા યોગ્ય relief/bypass arrangement જરૂરી છે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ અને ઉપયોગો

Inlet side પર teeth disengage થતાં cavity volume વધે છે અને liquid અંદર આવે છે.Trapped liquid gear teeth તથા casing વચ્ચેની outer periphery પરથી જાય છે, meshing contact મારફતે નહીં.Outlet પર teeth ફરી engage થઈ liquid discharge કરે છે.Compatible viscous lubricating liquids માટે ઉપયોગી છે.Abrasive solids, poor lubrication તથા excessive pressure માટે specific design જરૂરી છે.Flow displacement/speed તથા slip પર છે.Effective approved relief path વગર discharge બંધ ન કરો.

મૂળ સંબંધ

body.en:
Definition and principle

Characteristic curves relate head, efficiency, power and required NPSH to flow at a specified speed and impeller diameter. The operating point is the intersection of pump head and system head curves. Best efficiency point(BEP)is the peak of the efficiency curve, not automatically the actual operating point.

Important points

A typical radial pump shows decreasing developed head with increasing flow and a bell-shaped efficiency curve. Shaft power often rises with flow for that design, but the trend is not universal for all impellers. Power at shut-off is not generally zero even though hydraulic output is zero. System head includes static head and flow-dependent losses. Select a permitted operating range near the suitable efficiency region, not prolonged runout or shut-off.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા અને સિદ્ધાંત

Specified speed તથા impeller diameter પર flow સાથે head, efficiency, power તથા required NPSH નો સંબંધ Characteristic Curves બતાવે છે.Pump head તથા system head curves નું intersection Operating Point છે.Efficiency curve નું peak BEP છે; તે હંમેશાં actual operating point હોય એવું નથી.

મહત્વના મુદ્દા

Typical radial pump માં flow વધતાં developed head ઘટે છે અને efficiency curve bell-shaped હોય છે.આ design માં shaft power ઘણીવાર flow સાથે વધે છે, પણ દરેક impeller માટે આ universal નથી.Shut-off પર hydraulic output zero હોવા છતાં shaft power સામાન્ય રીતે zero નથી.System head માં static head તથા flow-dependent losses છે.Permitted efficient operating range પસંદ કરો; prolonged runout/shut-off નહીં.

body.en:
Definition and principle

Developed pump head is the increase in total mechanical energy per unit liquid weight between defined suction and discharge sections. Hydraulic power is the useful rate of energy supplied to the liquid. Pump efficiency compares hydraulic output with shaft input; motor efficiency is a separate conversion.

Important points

Include pressure, velocity and elevation differences; static pressure rise alone need not equal total head. Use the same density and pressure basis at both points. Convert volume flow to m³ s⁻¹ and power to W before substitution. Distinguish pump shaft input from electrical input; dividing by motor efficiency twice is incorrect.

Equations / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા અને સિદ્ધાંત

Defined suction તથા discharge sections વચ્ચે liquid ના એકમ weight દીઠ total mechanical energy નો વધારો Developed Head છે.Liquid ને મળતી useful energy rate Hydraulic Power છે.Pump efficiency hydraulic output ને shaft input સાથે સરખાવે છે.Motor efficiency અલગ conversion છે.

મહત્વના મુદ્દા

Pressure, velocity તથા elevation differences ત્રણેય લો.Static pressure rise હંમેશાં total head જેટલો નથી.બંને points પર consistent density તથા pressure basis લો.Volume flow m³ s⁻¹ તથા power W માં convert કરો.Pump shaft input તથા electrical input જુદા છે.Motor efficiency થી બે વાર ભાગ ન આપો.

સમીકરણો / સંકેતો

body.en:
Definition and principle

NPSH is suction total head above the liquid vapour-pressure head at the specified pump datum. Available NPSH comes from the system; required NPSH comes from pump performance at the stated flow/speed/test criterion. Cavitation occurs when local pressure falls sufficiently near/below vapour pressure to form vapour cavities that can collapse in higher-pressure regions.

Important points

Noise, vibration, head/efficiency loss and pitting can indicate cavitation, but air ingress or mechanical faults can resemble it. body.en:
Definition

A steam-jet ejector uses a high-velocity motive-steam jet to entrain lower-pressure gas/vapour.

Construction

It has a motive nozzle, suction chamber, mixing/throat section and diffuser. There are no rotating parts in the basic ejector. Multistage systems may use intercondensers to reduce vapour load between stages.

Working and applications

Steam expands through the nozzle and converts pressure energy into velocity. The jet creates conditions that draw process vapour into the suction chamber, mixes with it and transfers momentum. The diffuser slows the mixture and recovers pressure sufficiently for discharge to the designed downstream pressure. It is used for appropriate vacuum generation and vapour removal; performance depends on motive steam, suction load and backpressure. Steam/condensate handling and incompatibility with process material must be considered.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Steam-jet Ejector high-velocity motive-steam jet વડે lower-pressure gas/vapour entrain કરે છે.

રચના (Construction)

Motive nozzle, suction chamber, mixing/throat તથા diffuser મુખ્ય parts છે.Basic ejector માં rotating parts નથી.Multistage system માં stages વચ્ચે vapour load ઘટાડવા intercondensers હોઈ શકે છે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ અને ઉપયોગો

Steam nozzle માં expand થઈ pressure energy ને velocity માં ફેરવે છે.Jet suction chamber માં process vapour ખેંચે છે, mix થાય છે તથા momentum transfer કરે છે.Diffuser mixture ધીમું કરીને designed downstream pressure પર discharge માટે pressure recover કરે છે.Suitable vacuum generation તથા vapour removal માટે ઉપયોગી છે.Performance motive steam, suction load તથા backpressure પર આધારિત છે.Steam/condensate handling તથા process-material compatibility ધ્યાનમાં લો.

body.en:
Definition

A liquid-ring vacuum pump compresses gas in variable-volume pockets bounded by a rotating liquid ring.

Construction

An eccentrically mounted vaned rotor turns inside a casing partly filled with compatible seal liquid. Port plates connect expanding pockets to suction and contracting pockets to discharge. A separator/seal-liquid circuit handles outgoing gas and liquid.

Working and applications

Rotation distributes seal liquid into a ring along the casing. The eccentric rotor causes pocket volume to increase over the suction side, drawing gas in, and then decrease over the compression side, forcing gas toward discharge. The ring seals the pockets and absorbs heat. Seal-liquid temperature/vapour pressure limit attainable vacuum; cooling and correct liquid supply are essential. It handles suitable wet gases/vapours, but compatibility, carryover and power demand must be checked.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Liquid-ring Vacuum Pump rotating liquid ring થી bounded variable-volume pockets માં gas compress કરે છે.

રચના (Construction)

Compatible seal liquid ધરાવતા casing માં eccentric vaned rotor હોય છે.Port plates expanding pockets ને suction તથા contracting pockets ને discharge સાથે જોડે છે.Separator/seal-liquid circuit outgoing gas તથા liquid સંભાળે છે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ અને ઉપયોગો

Rotation થી seal liquid casing તરફ ring બનાવે છે.Eccentric rotor ના કારણે suction side પર pocket volume વધે છે અને gas અંદર આવે છે.Compression side પર volume ઘટતાં gas discharge થાય છે.Ring pockets seal કરે છે તથા heat લે છે.Seal-liquid temperature/vapour pressure attainable vacuum ને મર્યાદિત કરે છે.Cooling તથા યોગ્ય liquid supply જરૂરી છે.Suitable wet gases/vapours માટે ઉપયોગી છે, પણ compatibility, carryover તથા power demand તપાસો.

body.en:
Definition and principle

These machines supply energy to gases. A fan ordinarily provides a small pressure rise for ventilation/circulation; a blower serves a greater pressure-rise duty such as aeration or conveying; a compressor provides a substantial pressure increase where density changes become important. Exact naming limits vary by standard and design.

Important points

Rotodynamic fans/compressors use rotating blade rows; positive-displacement machines trap and compress gas in chambers. Roots-type blowers and reciprocating/screw compressors are examples, but suitability depends on the actual service. Compression may require cooling, staging, relief and surge/operating-range protection as applicable. Do not assign universal pressure-ratio cutoffs or use incompressible liquid-power equations for a strongly compressible gas without qualification.

આ machines gases ને energy આપે છે.Fan સામાન્ય રીતે ventilation/circulation માટે ઓછો pressure rise આપે છે.Blower aeration/conveying જેવી વધુ pressure-rise duty માટે છે.Compressor નોંધપાત્ર pressure increase આપે છે, જ્યાં density changes મહત્વના બને છે.Exact naming limits standard તથા design પ્રમાણે બદલાય છે.

મહત્વના મુદ્દા

Rotodynamic fans/compressors rotating blade rows વાપરે છે.Positive-displacement machines chambers માં gas trap/compress કરે છે.Roots-type blowers તથા reciprocating/screw compressors examples છે, પણ suitability actual service પર આધારિત છે.Compression માટે જરૂર મુજબ cooling, staging, relief તથા surge/operating-range protection જોઈએ.Universal pressure-ratio cutoffs ન આપો.Strongly compressible gas માટે incompressible liquid-power equations બિનશરતી ન વાપરો.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Pipe fittings and joints—classification and uses.
q.gu: Pipe Fittings તથા Joints—વર્ગીકરણ અને ઉપયોગો ની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: Fittings change direction, size, branching or termination of a piping path. Joints connect individual pipe/tube sections. Elbows/bends change direction, tees/wyes form branches, reducers connect sizes, couplings/unions join lengths and caps/plugs close ends. Threaded joints are detachable but depend on compatible threads/sealing; flanged joints use bolts and gaskets and permit equipment removal. Welded joints provide permanent connections requiring qualified procedures. Socket/compression/flared joints suit specified tube services. Selection depends on pressure, temperature, material, corrosion, cleanability, vibration and leakage risk. A union permits disconnection without rotating a whole pipe; it is not identical to an ordinary coupling.
a.gu: Piping path ની direction, size, branching અથવા termination બદલતા parts Fittings છે.Pipe/tube sections ને જોડતી connections Joints છે.Elbows/bends direction બદલે છે, tees/wyes branches, reducers size changes, couplings/unions lengths જોડે છે તથા caps/plugs ends બંધ કરે છે. Threaded joints detachable છે, પણ યોગ્ય threads/sealing જરૂરી છે.Flanged joint માં bolts તથા gasket હોય છે અને equipment removal સરળ બને છે.Welded joints permanent છે તથા qualified procedure જોઈએ.Socket/compression/flared joints specified tube services માટે છે.Pressure, temperature, material, corrosion, cleanability, vibration તથા leakage risk પ્રમાણે પસંદગી કરો.Union થી આખી pipe ફેરવ્યા વગર disconnect થાય છે; તે ordinary coupling જેવું નથી.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Gate valve.
q.gu: Gate Valve ની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A gate valve is primarily an isolation valve that opens a nearly straight flow passage by lifting a gate. A pressure-containing body and bonnet enclose seats and a wedge/parallel gate. The stem connects the gate to a handwheel/actuator, with packing controlling stem leakage. Rising-stem and non-rising-stem designs differ; the sketch shows a rising closure element. Turning the operator raises the gate away from both seats for full opening or lowers it into the seat region for shut-off. When fully open, obstruction and pressure loss are relatively low. Part-opening creates a high-velocity jet, vibration and seat/gate erosion, so an ordinary gate valve is not preferred for routine throttling. Use it for suitable line isolation; verify pressure direction, actuation and seating requirements for the actual design.
a.gu: Gate Valve મુખ્યત્વે isolation માટે છે; gate ઊંચું થતાં આશરે straight flow passage ખૂલે છે. Pressure-containing body તથા bonnet માં seats અને wedge/parallel gate હોય છે.Stem gate ને handwheel/actuator સાથે જોડે છે.Stem leakage માટે packing હોય છે.Rising તથા non-rising stem designs જુદા છે; sketch માં closure element ઊંચું થતું દર્શાવ્યું છે. Operator ફેરવતાં gate seats થી ઉપર જઈ full opening આપે છે અથવા નીચે આવી shut-off કરે છે.Fully open condition માં obstruction તથા pressure loss ઓછાં હોય છે.Part-opening માં high-velocity jet, vibration તથા seat/gate erosion થાય છે; તેથી ordinary gate valve routine throttling માટે યોગ્ય પસંદગી નથી.Compatible line isolation માટે વાપરો.Actual design ની pressure direction, actuation તથા seating requirements તપાસો.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Globe valve.
q.gu: Globe Valve ની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A globe valve controls flow by moving a disc/plug toward or away from a seat in a partitioned flow path. The body has an internal passage that changes flow direction, a bonnet, stem, packing, seat and handwheel/actuator. The stem movement is approximately normal to the seat opening. Lifting the disc increases the annular seat opening; lowering it reduces flow and eventually closes the passage. The local restriction permits controlled throttling, but the changing path causes greater pressure loss than a fully open straight-through isolation valve. It is useful for appropriate regulating service; follow the body flow arrow and allowable pressure drop to avoid erosion, cavitation or unstable operation.
a.gu: Globe Valve માં partitioned flow path ના seat તરફ/દૂર disc અથવા plug ખસેડીને flow control થાય છે. Body ની અંદર direction-changing passage, bonnet, stem, packing, seat તથા handwheel/actuator હોય છે.Stem movement આશરે seat opening ને normal હોય છે. Disc ઊંચો કરતાં seat ની annular opening વધે છે; નીચે કરતાં flow ઘટે છે અને અંતે passage બંધ થાય છે.Local restriction થી controlled throttling મળે છે, પણ direction-changing path ના કારણે fully open straight-through isolation valve કરતાં pressure loss વધારે છે.Regulating service માટે ઉપયોગી છે.Body નો flow arrow તથા allowable pressure drop અનુસરો, જેથી erosion, cavitation અથવા instability ટાળી શકાય.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Check valve.
q.gu: Check Valve ની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A check valve permits flow preferentially in one direction and closes against reverse flow. A swing-check example contains a body, seat, hinged disc and hinge pin; other designs use lift discs, balls or springs. It normally has no handwheel for routine opening. Forward differential pressure lifts or swings the disc from its seat. Reversal or reduced forward flow allows weight, spring force or reverse differential pressure to seat it. It prevents backflow in suitable pump lines but is not a universal positive-isolation substitute. Install in the specified orientation and direction. Rapid closure can contribute to water hammer; proper selection and system analysis matter.
a.gu: Check Valve એક direction માં flow પસાર કરે છે અને reverse flow સામે બંધ થાય છે. Swing-check example માં body, seat, hinged disc તથા hinge pin હોય છે.Other designs માં lift disc, ball અથવા spring હોઈ શકે છે.Routine opening માટે સામાન્ય રીતે handwheel નથી. Forward differential pressure થી disc seat થી ઊંચો થાય અથવા swing થાય છે.Flow reverse/ઘટતાં weight, spring અથવા reverse differential થી disc seat થાય છે.Pump lines માં suitable backflow prevention આપે છે, પણ universal positive-isolation substitute નથી.Specified orientation તથા direction માં install કરો.Rapid closure થી water hammer થઈ શકે છે; યોગ્ય selection તથા system analysis જરૂરી છે.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Butterfly valve.
q.gu: Butterfly Valve ની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A butterfly valve is a quarter-turn valve with a disc rotating inside the flow bore. The disc is carried by a shaft through the body and seals against a compatible resilient or metal seat. Bearings, seals and a lever/geared actuator support positioning; the disc remains in the passage even when open. With the disc plane roughly parallel to the flow, the passage is open. Rotation toward the transverse position restricts and then shuts flow. It is compact and useful for large-bore lines and appropriate control/isolation duties, but pressure rating, seat compatibility and permitted throttling range are design-dependent. High differential pressure can create torque, vibration or cavitation; it is not automatically suitable for every regulating condition.
a.gu: Butterfly Valve quarter-turn valve છે; flow bore ની અંદર disc rotate થાય છે. Body માંથી shaft disc ને support આપે છે અને compatible resilient અથવા metal seat પર sealing થાય છે.Bearings, seals તથા lever/geared actuator positioning માટે છે.Open હોય ત્યારે પણ disc passage માં રહે છે. Disc plane flow ને આશરે parallel હોય ત્યારે passage open છે.Transverse position તરફ rotate કરતાં restriction વધે છે અને flow બંધ થાય છે.Compact હોવાથી large-bore lines તથા suitable control/isolation માટે ઉપયોગી છે.Pressure rating, seat compatibility તથા throttling range design મુજબ છે.High differential pressure થી torque, vibration અથવા cavitation થઈ શકે છે; દરેક regulating condition માટે આપમેળે suitable નથી.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Ball valve.
q.gu: Ball Valve ની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A ball valve is a quarter-turn valve whose bored spherical closure aligns with or turns across the flow passage. The body encloses the ball, seats, stem and stem seals. A lever/actuator rotates the ball. Full-bore and reduced-bore designs have different internal flow areas. When the bore aligns with the pipe, fluid passes through it; approximately 90°rotation presents the solid ball surface to shut off flow. It provides rapid isolation and, for a full-bore open design, low flow resistance. Ordinary shut-off balls are not automatically precision throttling valves; use a suitable characterised control design when regulation is required. Trapped liquid between closed seats may require appropriate thermal-pressure protection.
a.gu: Ball Valve quarter-turn valve છે; તેના spherical closure નો bore flow passage સાથે align અથવા across થાય છે. Body માં ball, seats, stem તથા stem seals હોય છે.Lever/actuator ball rotate કરે છે.Full-bore તથા reduced-bore designs ના internal flow areas જુદા હોય છે. Bore pipe સાથે align હોય ત્યારે fluid પસાર થાય છે.આશરે 90°rotation પછી solid ball surface flow બંધ કરે છે.Rapid isolation તથા full-bore open design માં ઓછો resistance મળે છે.Ordinary shut-off ball valve precision throttling માટે આપમેળે suitable નથી; regulation માટે યોગ્ય characterised design લો.Closed seats વચ્ચે trapped liquid માટે યોગ્ય thermal-pressure protection જરૂરી થઈ શકે છે.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Classification and selection of pumps.
q.gu: Pumps નું વર્ગીકરણ તથા પસંદગી ની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A pump supplies mechanical energy to move a liquid or increase its pressure/head. First classify positive-displacement and rotodynamic pumps. Positive-displacement types include reciprocating piston/plunger/diaphragm and rotary gear/screw/vane pumps. Rotodynamic types include radial centrifugal, mixed-flow and axial-flow designs. Selection considers required flow/head, viscosity, solids, corrosion, temperature, NPSH, efficiency, sealing and maintenance. Positive-displacement delivery depends mainly on displacement and speed but leakage/compressibility affect actual flow; it must have suitable overpressure protection and must not be deadheaded. Centrifugal flow is set by pump/system-curve interaction, not impeller speed alone.
a.gu: Liquid ને ખસેડવા અથવા pressure/head વધારવા mechanical energy આપતું equipment Pump છે.પ્રથમ Positive-displacement તથા Rotodynamic વર્ગીકરણ કરો.Positive-displacement માં reciprocating piston/plunger/diaphragm તથા rotary gear/screw/vane types આવે છે.Rotodynamic માં radial centrifugal, mixed-flow તથા axial-flow designs આવે છે. Required flow/head, viscosity, solids, corrosion, temperature, NPSH, efficiency, sealing તથા maintenance પ્રમાણે પસંદગી કરો.Positive-displacement delivery મુખ્યત્વે displacement તથા speed પર છે, પણ leakage/compressibility actual flow ને અસર કરે છે.યોગ્ય overpressure protection જરૂરી છે; deadhead ન કરવો.Centrifugal flow pump/system curves ના intersection થી નક્કી થાય છે, ફક્ત speed થી નહીં.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Centrifugal pump.
q.gu: Centrifugal Pump ની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A centrifugal pump transfers shaft energy to liquid through a rotating impeller. A casing surrounds the impeller, with a central suction eye and tangential/appropriate discharge passage. The shaft, bearings, seal and driver support rotation. A volute or diffuser collects liquid and converts part of velocity energy into pressure; foot valves and priming connections are arrangement-dependent accessories. For a non-self-priming installation, fill the casing/suction route as required before start-up. The impeller accelerates incoming liquid outward and transfers angular momentum; the casing/diffuser recovers pressure. Lower eye pressure draws replacement liquid from the suction source. The actual operating flow is where pump and system head requirements agree. Use manufacturer start-up/valve instructions, never assume dry operation or prolonged shut-off is safe. Common uses include water and compatible low-to-moderate viscosity process liquids.
a.gu: Centrifugal Pump rotating impeller મારફતે shaft energy liquid ને આપે છે. Impeller આસપાસ casing, central suction eye તથા યોગ્ય discharge passage હોય છે.Shaft, bearings, seal તથા driver rotation માટે છે.Volute/diffuser liquid collect કરીને velocity energy નો ભાગ pressure માં ફેરવે છે.Foot valve તથા priming connections arrangement પ્રમાણેના accessories છે. Non-self-priming installation માં start-up પહેલાં SOP મુજબ casing/suction route ભરો.Impeller incoming liquid ને બહાર accelerate કરીને angular momentum આપે છે.Casing/diffuser pressure recover કરે છે.Eye પાસે ઓછા pressure થી source માંથી replacement liquid આવે છે.Pump તથા system head requirements મળતા operating flow મળે છે.Manufacturer ના start-up/valve instructions અનુસરો.Dry operation અથવા prolonged shut-off ને safe ન માનો.Water તથા compatible low-to-moderate viscosity liquids માટે સામાન્ય ઉપયોગ છે.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Reciprocating pump.
q.gu: Reciprocating Pump ની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A reciprocating pump is a positive-displacement machine using a piston/plunger moving within a cylinder. A crank/connecting mechanism converts shaft rotation to reciprocation. Suction and delivery non-return valves connect the chamber to their respective pipes. Seals and a suitable relief arrangement are essential; an air vessel may smooth pulsation but is not present in every rig. During the suction stroke, chamber volume increases, pressure falls and the suction valve admits liquid while the delivery valve remains closed. During delivery, the piston reduces chamber volume, the suction valve closes and the delivery valve opens when chamber pressure exceeds line pressure. Single-acting operation discharges on one stroke per cycle; double-acting operation uses both piston sides with rod-area correction. Pulsating delivery and leakage distinguish actual from theoretical flow. It suits appropriate low-flow/high-head or metering services.
a.gu: Reciprocating Pump cylinder માં piston/plunger ની આગળ-પાછળ motion થી કામ કરતું positive-displacement machine છે. Crank/connecting mechanism rotation ને reciprocation માં ફેરવે છે.Suction તથા delivery non-return valves chamber ને respective pipes સાથે જોડે છે.Seals તથા યોગ્ય relief arrangement જરૂરી છે.Air vessel pulsation ઘટાડી શકે છે, પણ દરેક rig માં હોવું જરૂરી નથી. Suction stroke માં chamber volume વધે છે, pressure ઘટે છે અને suction valve liquid અંદર લે છે; delivery valve બંધ રહે છે.Delivery stroke માં piston volume ઘટાડે છે, suction valve બંધ થાય છે અને chamber pressure line pressure કરતાં વધુ થતાં delivery valve ખૂલે છે.Single-acting માં cycle દીઠ એક stroke delivery આપે છે.Double-acting માં rod-area correction સાથે બંને sides કામ કરે છે.Pulsation તથા leakage થી actual/theoretical flow જુદા પડે છે.Low-flow/high-head અથવા suitable metering services માટે ઉપયોગી છે.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Rotary pump—external gear type.
q.gu: Rotary Pump—External Gear Type ની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A rotary positive-displacement pump traps liquid in moving cavities. An external-gear example has two meshing gears closely enclosed by a casing, one driven and the other idling. Suction and discharge ports lie on opposite sides of the mesh. Shaft seals, bearings and an appropriate relief/bypass arrangement complete the installation. As teeth disengage on the inlet side, cavity volume increases and liquid enters. Trapped liquid moves around the outer periphery between gear teeth and casing—not through the meshing contact. At the outlet, teeth re-engage and expel liquid against the delivery pressure. Gear pumps suit compatible viscous lubricating liquids; abrasive solids, poor lubrication and excessive pressure require specific design consideration. Flow depends on displacement/speed and slip; never close the discharge without an effective approved relief path.
a.gu: Rotary Positive-displacement Pump moving cavities માં liquid trap કરીને ખસેડે છે. External-gear example માં closely fitted casing ની અંદર બે meshing gears હોય છે; એક driven અને બીજો idler છે.Mesh ની opposite sides પર suction તથા discharge ports છે.Shaft seals, bearings તથા યોગ્ય relief/bypass arrangement જરૂરી છે. Inlet side પર teeth disengage થતાં cavity volume વધે છે અને liquid અંદર આવે છે.Trapped liquid gear teeth તથા casing વચ્ચેની outer periphery પરથી જાય છે, meshing contact મારફતે નહીં.Outlet પર teeth ફરી engage થઈ liquid discharge કરે છે.Compatible viscous lubricating liquids માટે ઉપયોગી છે.Abrasive solids, poor lubrication તથા excessive pressure માટે specific design જરૂરી છે.Flow displacement/speed તથા slip પર છે.Effective approved relief path વગર discharge બંધ ન કરો.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Centrifugal-pump characteristic curves.
q.gu: Centrifugal-pump Characteristic Curves ની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: Characteristic curves relate head, efficiency, power and required NPSH to flow at a specified speed and impeller diameter. The operating point is the intersection of pump head and system head curves. Best efficiency point(BEP)is the peak of the efficiency curve, not automatically the actual operating point. A typical radial pump shows decreasing developed head with increasing flow and a bell-shaped efficiency curve. Shaft power often rises with flow for that design, but the trend is not universal for all impellers. Power at shut-off is not generally zero even though hydraulic output is zero. System head includes static head and flow-dependent losses. Select a permitted operating range near the suitable efficiency region, not prolonged runout or shut-off.
a.gu: Specified speed તથા impeller diameter પર flow સાથે head, efficiency, power તથા required NPSH નો સંબંધ Characteristic Curves બતાવે છે.Pump head તથા system head curves નું intersection Operating Point છે.Efficiency curve નું peak BEP છે; તે હંમેશાં actual operating point હોય એવું નથી. Typical radial pump માં flow વધતાં developed head ઘટે છે અને efficiency curve bell-shaped હોય છે.આ design માં shaft power ઘણીવાર flow સાથે વધે છે, પણ દરેક impeller માટે આ universal નથી.Shut-off પર hydraulic output zero હોવા છતાં shaft power સામાન્ય રીતે zero નથી.System head માં static head તથા flow-dependent losses છે.Permitted efficient operating range પસંદ કરો; prolonged runout/shut-off નહીં.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Developed head,hydraulic power and efficiencies.
q.gu: Developed Head,Hydraulic Power તથા Efficiencies ની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: Developed pump head is the increase in total mechanical energy per unit liquid weight between defined suction and discharge sections. Hydraulic power is the useful rate of energy supplied to the liquid. Pump efficiency compares hydraulic output with shaft input; motor efficiency is a separate conversion. Include pressure, velocity and elevation differences; static pressure rise alone need not equal total head. Use the same density and pressure basis at both points. Convert volume flow to m³ s⁻¹ and power to W before substitution. Distinguish pump shaft input from electrical input; dividing by motor efficiency twice is incorrect.

q.en: State the definition/principle of NPSH and cavitation—definition,identification and prevention.
q.gu: NPSH તથા Cavitation—વ્યાખ્યા,ઓળખ અને અટકાવ ની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: NPSH is suction total head above the liquid vapour-pressure head at the specified pump datum. Available NPSH comes from the system; required NPSH comes from pump performance at the stated flow/speed/test criterion. Cavitation occurs when local pressure falls sufficiently near/below vapour pressure to form vapour cavities that can collapse in higher-pressure regions. Noise, vibration, head/efficiency loss and pitting can indicate cavitation, but air ingress or mechanical faults can resemble it. Increase available suction head, reduce suction losses, avoid unsuitable liquid temperature and select a pump/operating point with adequate margin above the specified requirement. Do not throttle suction to solve cavitation. NPSHA exceeding a quoted NPSHR alone is not a guarantee of zero cavitation; manufacturer/design margin is needed.
a.gu: Specified pump datum પર suction total head તથા liquid vapour-pressure head નો તફાવત NPSH છે.Available NPSH system પરથી અને Required NPSH pump ના stated flow/speed/test criterion પરથી મળે છે.Local pressure vapour pressure નજીક/નીચે જતાં vapour cavities બને છે અને higher-pressure region માં collapse થાય તેને Cavitation કહે છે. Noise, vibration, head/efficiency loss તથા pitting cavitation ના indicators છે, પણ air ingress અથવા mechanical faults પણ આવાં symptoms આપી શકે છે.Available suction head વધારો, suction losses ઘટાડો, અયોગ્ય liquid temperature ટાળો તથા required value ઉપર adequate margin વાળો pump/operating point પસંદ કરો.Cavitation સુધારવા suction throttle ન કરો.Quoted NPSHR કરતાં NPSHA વધારે હોય એટલાથી zero cavitation ની guarantee નથી; manufacturer/design margin જરૂરી છે.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Steam-jet ejector.
q.gu: Steam-jet Ejector ની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A steam-jet ejector uses a high-velocity motive-steam jet to entrain lower-pressure gas/vapour. It has a motive nozzle, suction chamber, mixing/throat section and diffuser. There are no rotating parts in the basic ejector. Multistage systems may use intercondensers to reduce vapour load between stages. Steam expands through the nozzle and converts pressure energy into velocity. The jet creates conditions that draw process vapour into the suction chamber, mixes with it and transfers momentum. The diffuser slows the mixture and recovers pressure sufficiently for discharge to the designed downstream pressure. It is used for appropriate vacuum generation and vapour removal; performance depends on motive steam, suction load and backpressure. Steam/condensate handling and incompatibility with process material must be considered.
a.gu: Steam-jet Ejector high-velocity motive-steam jet વડે lower-pressure gas/vapour entrain કરે છે. Motive nozzle, suction chamber, mixing/throat તથા diffuser મુખ્ય parts છે.Basic ejector માં rotating parts નથી.Multistage system માં stages વચ્ચે vapour load ઘટાડવા intercondensers હોઈ શકે છે. Steam nozzle માં expand થઈ pressure energy ને velocity માં ફેરવે છે.Jet suction chamber માં process vapour ખેંચે છે, mix થાય છે તથા momentum transfer કરે છે.Diffuser mixture ધીમું કરીને designed downstream pressure પર discharge માટે pressure recover કરે છે.Suitable vacuum generation તથા vapour removal માટે ઉપયોગી છે.Performance motive steam, suction load તથા backpressure પર આધારિત છે.Steam/condensate handling તથા process-material compatibility ધ્યાનમાં લો.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Liquid-ring vacuum pump.
q.gu: Liquid-ring Vacuum Pump ની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A liquid-ring vacuum pump compresses gas in variable-volume pockets bounded by a rotating liquid ring. An eccentrically mounted vaned rotor turns inside a casing partly filled with compatible seal liquid. Port plates connect expanding pockets to suction and contracting pockets to discharge. A separator/seal-liquid circuit handles outgoing gas and liquid. Rotation distributes seal liquid into a ring along the casing. The eccentric rotor causes pocket volume to increase over the suction side, drawing gas in, and then decrease over the compression side, forcing gas toward discharge. The ring seals the pockets and absorbs heat. Seal-liquid temperature/vapour pressure limit attainable vacuum; cooling and correct liquid supply are essential. It handles suitable wet gases/vapours, but compatibility, carryover and power demand must be checked.
a.gu: Liquid-ring Vacuum Pump rotating liquid ring થી bounded variable-volume pockets માં gas compress કરે છે. Compatible seal liquid ધરાવતા casing માં eccentric vaned rotor હોય છે.Port plates expanding pockets ને suction તથા contracting pockets ને discharge સાથે જોડે છે.Separator/seal-liquid circuit outgoing gas તથા liquid સંભાળે છે. Rotation થી seal liquid casing તરફ ring બનાવે છે.Eccentric rotor ના કારણે suction side પર pocket volume વધે છે અને gas અંદર આવે છે.Compression side પર volume ઘટતાં gas discharge થાય છે.Ring pockets seal કરે છે તથા heat લે છે.Seal-liquid temperature/vapour pressure attainable vacuum ને મર્યાદિત કરે છે.Cooling તથા યોગ્ય liquid supply જરૂરી છે.Suitable wet gases/vapours માટે ઉપયોગી છે, પણ compatibility, carryover તથા power demand તપાસો.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Fans,blowers and compressors.
q.gu: Fans,Blowers તથા Compressors ની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: These machines supply energy to gases. A fan ordinarily provides a small pressure rise for ventilation/circulation; a blower serves a greater pressure-rise duty such as aeration or conveying; a compressor provides a substantial pressure increase where density changes become important. Exact naming limits vary by standard and design. Rotodynamic fans/compressors use rotating blade rows; positive-displacement machines trap and compress gas in chambers. Roots-type blowers and reciprocating/screw compressors are examples, but suitability depends on the actual service. Compression may require cooling, staging, relief and surge/operating-range protection as applicable. Do not assign universal pressure-ratio cutoffs or use incompressible liquid-power equations for a strongly compressible gas without qualification.
a.gu: આ machines gases ને energy આપે છે.Fan સામાન્ય રીતે ventilation/circulation માટે ઓછો pressure rise આપે છે.Blower aeration/conveying જેવી વધુ pressure-rise duty માટે છે.Compressor નોંધપાત્ર pressure increase આપે છે, જ્યાં density changes મહત્વના બને છે.Exact naming limits standard તથા design પ્રમાણે બદલાય છે. Rotodynamic fans/compressors rotating blade rows વાપરે છે.Positive-displacement machines chambers માં gas trap/compress કરે છે.Roots-type blowers તથા reciprocating/screw compressors examples છે, પણ suitability actual service પર આધારિત છે.Compression માટે જરૂર મુજબ cooling, staging, relief તથા surge/operating-range protection જોઈએ.Universal pressure-ratio cutoffs ન આપો.Strongly compressible gas માટે incompressible liquid-power equations બિનશરતી ન વાપરો.
